title: Lazy blocks
description: Lazy Blocks adds three automation blocks that handle tree farming, fish collecting and crop harvesting so you don't have to.
body: # Lazy Blocks Lazy Blocks adds three automation blocks that handle tree farming, fish collecting and crop harvesting so you don't have to. --- ## 🌳 Tree Cutter Place a sapling, add bone meal and an axe — the Tree Cutter chops the tree automatically, depositing logs, leaves, and apples into its output slots. ## 🌾 Crop Harvester Place a seed or crop, add bone meal and a hoe — the Crop Harvester handles the rest. Supports all vanilla crops, and if you're playing with Farmer's Delight or Vinery, those crops work too. Watch out for the occasional poisonous potato or rotten tomato! 🥔🍅 # 🐟 Fish Collector Place a main input ( kelp, seagrass, sea pickle or lily pad), add bone meal and an fishing rod — the Fish Collector collect fish, junk and treasure for you automatically, depositing items into its output slots. Fish collector use real vanilla fishing loot by default ( with upgrades is just better for treasure😉). --- ## ⚙️ Upgrades All three blocks support the same upgrade system: | Speed I / II / III | Faster cycles (default is 30s, every upgrade is 20% less) | | Efficiency I / II / III | Less bone meal per cycle (default is 4, every upgrade is 1 less) | | Durability I / II / III | Less tool durability per cycle (default is 4, every upgrade is 1 less) | | Yield | 50% More output per cycle | | Multi-Slot | Process up to 3 saplings, crops or kelps at once | | Auto Export | Automatically exports to adjacent chests and barrels | | Save Tool | Moves tool to output before it breaks | **Tree Cutter exclusive:** | Leaf Collector | Chance to collect leaves alongside logs | | Apple Harvester | Extra chance to drop apples | **Crop Harvester exclusive:** | Non-Toxic | Removes poisonous potato and rotten tomato drops | **Fish Collector exclusive:** | Treasure Hunter | Removes fish, so you have a better chance of finding treasure | | Luck I / II / III | Better chance for treasure | --- ## 🔌 Mod Compatibility - ✅ Farmer's Delight — tomatoes, onions, cabbage, rice... - ✅ Vinery — all grape variants - ✅ Biomes O' Plenty - ✅ Oh The Biomes You'll Go - ✅ Autumnity - ✅ Atmospheric - ✅ Aquaculture 2 - ✅ JEI — full recipe integration All compatibility is optional. The mod works perfectly fine without any of these installed. --- ## 📦 Setup Every block accept input from hoppers on the top and sides. Output can be extracted from the bottom via hopper, or automatically pushed to adjacent chests and barrels with the Auto Export upgrade. All values (output counts, chances, cycle speed) are configurable via the config file. If you use a mod that doesn't have compatibility with Lazy Blocks, you can tell me and I will add it, or you can simply add it yourself via the config file. --- ## 🔮 Future Plans - Ports to newer Minecraft versions --- # Update 1.19.2 - Added Tree Cutter, Crop Harvester and 16 upgrades (First release) 1.19.2 v2 - Added Fish Collector, 4 new upgrades and fixed bugs(display names, compatibility) 1.19.2 v3 - Fixed bugs(Fish collector input, compatibility) 1.19.3 - Updated to 1.19.3 1.19.4 - Updated to 1.19.4 1.20.1 - Updated to 1.20.1. Added cherry tree. --- ## 📝 Notes This mod was developed with the assistance of AI, with every feature reviewed, tested and refined by me personally before release. The mod has been played and tested prior to publishing — no bugs were noticed, but if you encounter any issues please leave a comment or open an issue and I'll look into it. Your feedback is greatly appreciated! ❗Gifs are used in the text, which makes the cycle seem faster than it is❗ ❗Fish Collector does not need to be in or near water to work.❗ ❗Tree Cutter does not need to be near trees to work.❗ ❗Crop Harvester does not need to be near water or farmland to work.❗ _Crafting recipes are available in JEI and the recipe book._ \*Made by Pavaa\*
